title: Construct K Palindrome Strings
summary: Determine if all characters in a string can be used to form at least one non-empty k palindrome string.
statement: Determine if all characters in a string can be used to form at least one non-empty k palindrome string.
constraints: Use every character exactly once across exactly k non-empty palindrome strings.
hints: Each odd-frequency character needs a palindrome center.
The odd-count total therefore cannot exceed k.
Also k cannot exceed the number of characters because palindromes are non-empty.
When both bounds hold, pairs can be split to reach exactly k.
editorial: When both bounds hold, pairs can be split to reach exactly k.

tests.explanation: Two odd counts can supply the required palindrome centers.
Five odd counts require at least five centers, so three is impossible.
